label: Chronic low back pain / mild arthritis
red_flag_symptoms: numbness around the groin or saddle area
new loss of bladder or bowel control
progressive weakness in one or both legs
pain that is worse at night or at rest
sources: ACSM guidance on exercise for chronic low back pain
WHO 2020 Guidelines on physical activity and sedentary behaviour
guidance: Gentle mobility and walking usually help more than complete rest.
Stop any movement that causes sharp or radiating pain.
Favour supported positions over deep loaded bending or twisting.
